# Instructions for ui.frontend.spa

This module contains SPA-related frontend code integrated with AEM.

## Guidance
- Follow existing SPA architecture and conventions already used in this module.
- Preserve routing, data flow, and AEM integration patterns.
- Keep changes targeted and easy to review.
- Avoid broad rewrites unless explicitly requested.

## AEM integration
- Be mindful of authored content rendering, model mapping, and SPA-to-AEM integration expectations.
- Explain the impact of component or route changes on AEM-authored experiences when relevant.

## Quality
- Keep code modular, readable, and maintainable.
- Avoid duplication and large multi-purpose components.
